title: The Turnaround!

baseline.observation: All supplied skills are used. Lemming 1 remains an active Blocker at x=992, foot y=52 through tick 1022; 99 other lemmings exit.

boundedChecks: 329 original, deleted-command and single-command retime variants: 259 complete native replays, no win; best 99/100.
1344 two-command retimes of the seven-command route without the Blocker: 901 complete native replays, no win; best 99/100.
2025 one-skill substitutions after deleting one redundant Basher, Digger or Miner command, over lemming IDs 2-6 and ticks 280-360: 2025 complete native replays, no win; best 99/100.
Source-built solver continuations after deleting the first Basher or first Digger completed 815 and 810 one-skill rollouts through waiting tick 1022, respectively, without a win.
conclusion: The 99/100 route is a misleading near-win for the 100% objective: its Blocker cannot remain behind. Removing that Blocker makes this route save zero; the tested timing and one-skill substitutions do not free or replace it. A different construction or a way to release the Blocker is required. These bounded checks do not prove the level impossible and do not establish source physics parity. No winning replay or score was added.
